explication: Rainbell is a pair of Chinese and English example Obsidian vaults, centered on a personalized homepage dashboard. The user opens the homepage to navigate periodic notes and view daily-note sections, project progress, reading status, and activity; the vault also demonstrates note organization and task-calendar and word-count views. README statements establish the dashboard capabilities and plugin dependencies. The task-calendar and word-count scripts are sampled, but most homepage and plugin wiring is not, so unverified runtime links are omitted.
